target_audience.demographics: Women aged 20-35 in the UAE and wider Gulf region.
target_audience.psychographics: Ingredient-conscious, active on Instagram and TikTok, want effective, no-nonsense skincare without the luxury markup.
pain_points: Most skincare formulas aren't designed for hot, humid Gulf climates
Luxury brands charge a premium without ingredient transparency
Hard to know which routine actually works for their skin

competitors_or_market: D2C and luxury skincare brands available in the UAE
unique_value_proposition: Transparent, dermatologist-reviewed formulations at accessible prices, climate-specific products designed for heat and humidity, and fast regional shipping.
additional_context: Currently focused on growing TikTok and Instagram Reels content. Ships across UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar. Considering an Eid gifting bundle campaign.
